headline: The STI edged up 0.1% to 4,958.87 on Tuesday, with banks slightly higher. Overnight Wall Street gave back part of Monday's AI rally: Nasdaq -1.5%, Nvidia -5.9%, but the Dow rose. Brent is near a 3-month low. US GDP and PCE data are due tonight; a December Fed hike is nearly fully priced.
